notes.title: Update - V 1.4.1
notes.content:
Dear Commanders,

We’re thrilled to introduce this major update!

[h2]New Platform[/h2]
  [list]
[*] The game is now available on the [b]Steam Deck![/b] We're also working with Steam to earn the compatibility badge.
[/list]

[h2]Under the Hood[/h2]
  [list]
[*] Future-proofed the game by [b]upgrading [/b]Unity from 2021 to 2023.
[*] Enhanced overall performance, particularly on skirmish maps with many ships.
[/list]

[h2]UI/UX Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Introduced a [b]General View[/b]: zoom out to see color-coded planets and ships
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477180/f6e887cca479b165a0a406ec40e02aa4110e30d2.png[/img]
[*] Improved enemy ship coloring, including red thrusters for easier enemy identification.
[*] [b]Added voice-overs for in-game dialogue[/b].
[/list]

We welcome all feedback, whether positive, negative, or constructive. Contact us at wecureboredom@proton.me.

Happy gaming,
The We Cure Boredom Team

notes.title: New Skirmish mode is LIVE - V 1.1.5
notes.content:
Attention Commanders,

We've heard your call for change, and we're excited to introduce an new update!

Get ready for the all-new Infinite Resources - Skirmish Mode! No longer will you be constrained by scarcity—now, resources flow endlessly, giving you the freedom to focus on what truly matters: domination. But that's not all! We've supercharged ship production by implementing a build multiplier on select planets' shipyards. Watch your fleet multiply before your eyes as you prepare to conquer the cosmos like never before!

But wait, there's more:
[list]
[*] Solved a bug which affected gameplay speed, overall experience is drastically improved making it more dynamic
[*] Rally point HUD has now a bright orange indicator when being active
[/list]

Happy gaming,
The We Cure Boredom Team

notes.title: Update V102
notes.content:
Dear Commanders,

We appreciate your valuable feedback, and we've taken the following actions to enhance your gaming experience:

[list]
[*]Resolved the issue with WASD and screen edge camera movement not functioning
[*]Rectified the problem with the Select Menu icon not disappearing
[*]Addressed the HUD ship counter not updating
[*]Fixed game-breaking bugs occurring in higher levels
[*]Lowered the volume on various combat audio clips
[*]Enhanced the visual effects of lasers
[/list]

Wishing you a Happy New Year from the Cure Boredom team! 
May your gaming adventures be out of this world, in a galaxy free from extraterrestrial interference!
